findings.detail: P2_SEEG_ts_fit.npz, P2_TI_SEEG_ts_fit.npz and VepMrtrixLut.txt sha256 + byte size match data/wang-5367ef4-manifest.csv
npz loads with allow_pickle=False; keys time_steps, seeg, SC, gain, ch_names; shapes coherent (191 ch, 162 regions)
191 unique bipolar names; gain rows = 191; identical channel lists, SC and gain across both sessions
uniform steps (8 ms in ses-seegstim, 10 ms in ses-tistim); no gaps; unit not stored -> sample rate inferred (125 / 100 Hz). The two sessions have DIFFERENT sampling rates: per-file rate must be used.
0 NaN, 0 Inf in signals, gain and SC
no channel with std < 1e-9; no channel below 1% of median std; longest run of identical consecutive samples = 1
no channel with >1% of samples at its extreme value
no frames identical to the previous frame; no leading/trailing constant padding

raw values span -6.02..5.38 (per-channel means about -6..+5.4) while median per-channel std is 0.0019 (ses-seegstim) / 0.0128 (ses-tistim): large static offsets dominate the raw values; models must handle per-channel offset (data-centred priors per A0001).

many >20 MAD sample-to-sample jumps, all inside the initial transient and the stimulation epochs (pulse-train / TI waveform), plus the post-stimulation event. ses-seegstim: 0 of 14244 flagged samples outside these epochs; ses-tistim: 76 of 33383 outside, all in the low-amplitude baseline 470-1000 ms where the per-channel MAD threshold is very small (late tail of the initial transient), not abrupt steps
both sessions start with a decaying transient (ses-seegstim ~8-200 ms; ses-tistim ~10-450 ms), likely from initial conditions; consider excluding from fitting
ses-seegstim: 50-Hz train ~504-3504 ms (below the 62.5-Hz Nyquist at 125 Hz); ses-tistim: ~5-Hz periodic drive ~1010-3000 ms. These epochs are driven responses, not spontaneous activity.
ses-seegstim spectral peak at 50 Hz besides slow (<1 Hz) power; ses-tistim peak at ~5 Hz
atlas-level only: SC 162x162 symmetric, zero diagonal, max 1; gain 191x162 positive, no zero rows/cols. No MRI, no contact coordinates: contact-in-brain and transform checks not applicable.
npz has no region-label key; LUT order (1..162) assumed for SC/gain columns
no generating parameters, EZ labels or stimulation settings are present in the npz files; ground truth extracted only to the separate truth file for sealing

missingness.event_annotations: reported_absent (epochs derived from signals by R2)

ground_truth_extraction.summary: EZ identity unambiguous and consistent across the reserved notebooks; generating parameter values are session-specific (SEEG-stim vs TI configurations differ); which of two SEEG notebooks produced P2_SEEG_ts_fit.npz is ambiguous, but both carry the same region-level EZ configuration. Details only in the sealed file.

verdict_reasons: Signals clean (no NaN, flat, clipped or padded channels) and checksummed; channels/SC/gain coherent across sessions.

Limits: simulated data with undeclared units and inferred sample rates (125 vs 100 Hz between sessions); atlas-level anatomy only (no MRI/coordinates); large per-channel DC offsets; initial transients and stimulation-driven epochs should be handled explicitly by the observation model.
